findings.passage: His priorities include supporting local jobs, workers and small businesses; backing efforts to secure the border and protect Pennsylvanians; boosting American energy independence to stop price hikes; upholding election integrity by supporting commonsense voter ID; and giving parents more control over their children’s education.
findings.note: From the About page of his official site, written in the third person. Lists support for what it calls commonsense voter ID among his priorities. No details of what the ID rule would be. Page date not shown.

findings.passage: Bashline is a strong advocate and protector of the Second Amendment and wants to bring more family-sustaining jobs to his district while cutting intrusive government red tape.
findings.note: Official biography page describing his stance on the Second Amendment (undated page).

findings.passage: “I am pleased to host this event once again to give law-abiding citizens pertinent information on how they can legally protect themselves, their families and their properties,” said Bashline.
findings.note: Quote in his office's release announcing his annual concealed carry seminar (date per page).

findings.passage: Bashline highlighted his voting record, noting support for pro-life legislation, Second Amendment protections, small businesses, energy development and agriculture.
findings.note: Outlet's report of how he described his own record at his re-election launch; paraphrase by the outlet, not a direct quote.
